userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: Family: withheld. No evaluation has run for the stay yet.
Family: withheld. An open stay with no further read, closed with an inferred end; left out of compliance rates.
Family: compliant. Exempt by a plate list entry (Part 24) that covered the entry time.
Family: compliant. Covered by rights, and a permit contributed to the coverage.
Family: compliant. Covered by rights, and a reservation contributed to the coverage (no permit did).
Family: compliant. Covered by payments only.
Family: compliant. Nothing paid, and the whole stay fell within the grace (Part 19 §19.10 rule 7).
Family: compliant. The stay was in a valet area that is not enforced.
Family: violation. Arrived before a reservation's start, beyond its early grace, and the time before the start was not otherwise covered.
Family: violation. Stayed past a reservation's end by more than the grace, and the time after it was not otherwise covered.
Family: violation. Closed, nothing paid, and the stay was longer than the grace.
Family: violation. Coverage began more than the entry grace after entry, or, while the stay is open, has not begun at all.
Family: violation. Coverage began in time, but the stay outlasted it by more than the exit grace.
Family: violation. Longer than the place's maximum stay. Never overrides fromList.
Family: withheld. Would be a violation, but a person must look first; pendingStatus names which (Part 5 §5.9 rule 2).
Family: other. Paid after exit, settling the amount: paid, but not compliant.
